description: Bounded AgileX real-robot server delta on top of the released pi05_horizon layer; no checkpoints or datasets.

source_workspace.name: pi05_horizon_server
source_workspace.version_control: Local working tree without .git; source bytes are identified by per-file SHA-256.

contract.state_input: Raw AgileX state with last dimension >=26; concatenate [13:20, 0:7] into left7/right7.
contract.action_training_input: Raw AgileX action with last dimension >=14; concatenate [7:14, 0:7] into left7/right7.
contract.action_output: 14-D left7/right7 absolute joint and gripper commands, with adapt_to_pi=False.
contract.normalization: PI05 defaults to checkpoint quantile stats; joints use deltas to observation state, grippers remain absolute. Explicit use_quantile_norm_override remains available.
contract.trace: v [steps,horizon,model_dim], ds [steps], x0/xt_internal [horizon,model_dim]; normalized padded model coordinates, singleton batch removed, floating arrays cast to float32 for msgpack.
contract.dataset: CHUNKTRUST_AGILEX_DATASET overrides the portable dataset id; inference reads checkpoint assets and requires no training dataset.
contract.norm_stats_fallback: Use the requested checkpoint asset_id when present. If missing, use a fallback only when exactly one assets/*/norm_stats.json exists; multiple or zero alternatives raise.

changes: Export the local AgileX raw-state/action alignment and camera mapping.
Replace the source workstation dataset path with CHUNKTRUST_AGILEX_DATASET and a portable default dataset id.
Merge only AgilexRealAlohaDataConfig, its alignment import and pi05_base_aloha_agilex_real_full registration into the released config.
Retain the newer public multi-task config, QHA history transforms and portable ChunkTrust path resolution.
Merge the local floating trace -> float32 serialization helper into the released policy.
Keep all released QHA feature traces, teacher outputs, reset_rng and infer_with_forked_rng implementations.
Trace coordinates remain normalized model space and bypass action output transforms.
Add the local singleton checkpoint normalization asset fallback at both full-policy and base-plus-QHA loaders.
Retain the released resolved-model-config loading and QHA candidate overrides.
Expose --return-denoise-trace and pass its sampler kwargs for explicit and default checkpoints.
